moments.title: UK Heatwave Peaks Today
moments.blurb: An amber extreme heat warning is in force for parts of England as temperatures are forecast to hit up to 38C today, marking the peak of the current heatwave before conditions ease.

angles.name: Heat Alert
angles.copy: Stay safe and hydrated today, UK! Temperatures could hit 38C in some areas as the heatwave peaks. Amber warnings are in place. #HeatwaveUK

angles.name: Cool Down Tips
angles.copy: Hottest day of the year for many? We're peaking at 38C today! What's your top tip for staying cool when the mercury soars?

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The men's and women's finals of The Hundred cricket competition will take place this Sunday, August 16, at Lord's Cricket Ground in London.

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred this Sunday! Who are you backing to lift the trophy at Lord's? #TheHundred

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: The Home of Cricket, Lord's, hosts The Hundred finals this Sunday! London is buzzing for the big game. #LondonCricket

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins next Friday, August 21, with Manchester United playing Hull City away on August 22 and Manchester City facing Arsenal on August 16.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: Less than 10 days until the Premier League kicks off! Who's ready for the return of top-flight football? #PL

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: The Premier League fixtures are out! Man Utd, Arsenal, Man City all in action next weekend. Who's got the toughest start?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating world-class music, wellness, and culture, runs from August 20-23 in Dorset and is now sold out.

angles.name: Festival Vibes

angles.name: Dorset Sounds
angles.copy: The South West is getting its groove on next week as We Out Here Festival brings its unique blend of music and good vibes to Dorset.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean UK No.1

angles.copy: Still at number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean with 'Rein Me In' dominating the UK Singles Chart. Deserved? #UKChart

angles.name: Power Duo
angles.copy: From BRITs winner to chart-topper! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are a force to be reckoned with. What's your favourite lyric from 'Rein Me In'?
